name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 2 No 25

clue.text: One put in halo is the Faerie Queene
Iberian city, left in holes, is seen
The Attic wit of superstitious thrower
One of the Browns will have to give you power
False lips will need me, having guileless touch
Methinks ‘the lady doth protest too much’
A larcenist from Injia’s sunny clime?
Through missing school, let these be these in time
This voice will cope with tales oft torn asunder
Forsake the Church and, by extortion, plunder
This diamond sometimes has a chocolate coat
Cheese left by snake-haired hag, this Frenchman wrote
A trick by Goblin, loved by Aphrodite
This bookman finds fermenting ale trite
Picked up in market? Just a trifle, say
Ride, Great-Aunt Betsey, sling the wood away!
Wrong-footed cowboy lacking social grace
Make memory call for storm around the place
A constable gives knave a fruit that’s blue?
The layman’s clavicle: seize one, seize two
How endless stay with Edward ‘fixed’ became
Psalterian source of mass-producer’s name
Stagger — for University is hard
Step up the case that’s drifting in retard
Fast said, this ugly man fast food supplies
Advert portrays a king in ’ealthy guise
Is fate untoward, such leisure time to yield?
The love of Kreutzer Operas thus concealed
